draft.subject: Embedded firmware background and interest in Ommo
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I came across the Senior Firmware Engineer opening at Ommo, and since you work in embedded firmware there, you seemed like the right person to reach out to.

My background is in low level embedded systems, including bare metal C on STM32 peripherals such as timers and ADC, and FreeRTOS based systems with mutex protected task coordination for sensor driven control. I have also designed and fabricated my own PCBs and wired up sensor communication over UART and I2C end to end.

I do not have the years of experience the senior posting calls for yet, but the precision embedded work Ommo is building is what I want to grow into. If your team ever has room for someone earlier in their firmware career, I would appreciate hearing about it.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
draft.hook_used: Junyu Lu is an Embedded Firmware Engineer at Ommo, same technical domain as the Senior Firmware Engineer role analyzed, direct peer connection rather than a generic recruiter hook
